name: Wand of Lightning Bolts

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 7 charges: Lightning Bolt (save DC 15), one charge per level above 3rd.
text: While you hold it, the wand's 7 charges fuel Lightning Bolt castings with a save DC of 15. A single charge produces the level 3 spell, and every extra charge you add lifts the level by 1. Each dawn it gets back 1d6 + 1 charges. Using up the final charge calls for a 1d20 roll; on a 1 the wand falls to ash and is destroyed.
